title: Billing Transaction Failed
description: A Mercury webhook command could not be handled: Mercury or the ledger stayed unavailable through the last delivery attempt, the read key is unusable, or something unexpected failed before the sync committed. Nothing was written; the nightly backstop heals it. Routed loud by ntfy-router. Carries the command_id, batch and read window; never an amount, a counterparty, a note or a category. id = uuid5(NS_MERCURY_HOOK, command_id + ':' + type). Ordered by ledger:global (AAI's bank is no client's). Emitted by milkshake-farm-consumer. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (billing, transaction) and Milkshake docs/farm-commands.md 16.7.6.
